description: Classification rules for observed GraphQL responses. Resource ownership expectations come from the reviewed test case, not benchmark configuration names.

outcomes.allow: PASS only when the requested target (and required allowed property, if any) is evidenced; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
outcomes.deny_object: POLICY_VIOLATION when the target object is returned; PASS when absent/null without a relevant GraphQL error; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
outcomes.deny_property: POLICY_VIOLATION when the selected restricted property has a non-null returned value; PASS when withheld/null without a relevant GraphQL error; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.

verdicts.PASS: Observed response satisfies the expected access policy.
verdicts.POLICY_VIOLATION: Observed response contains the seeded unauthorized object or restricted property.
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: Evidence is insufficient or cannot be reliably classified.
